inputs.proposed_invalidation: Reject the edge if deployments fail to broaden beyond concentrated customers, contracted capacity is delayed or cancelled, or fuel, emissions, reliability and cost economics erase the time-to-power advantage.
inputs.proposed_mechanism: Grid interconnection delays can transmit into Bloom demand because modular onsite firm power may shorten time to power for AI data centers; Oracle deployment, hyperscaler approvals and Q2 growth provide issuer-specific evidence.

objective: Review whether Bloom Energy has a material causal relationship to AI infrastructure power bottlenecks through rapidly deployed onsite firm power; accept or reject the edge.
